name: Button
purpose: Interactive trigger for a single decisive action. The most common interactive primitive — use exactly one primary per intent. Variant signals hierarchy.

variants.name: primary
variants.use: the single most important action on a view

variants.name: destructive
variants.use: irreversible actions; always paired with confirm

accessibility.keyboard: Enter and Space activate; reachable in tab order
accessibility.focus: visible focus ring; never remove outline without replacement
accessibility.screenReader: accessible name from label or aria-label; loading state announced

antiPatterns: two primary buttons side by side
buttons used for navigation (use a link)
destructive variant without a confirm step
hard-coded colour instead of token binding
